product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Premium Mobile TV CartPremium mobile, tilting mount with media shelf for most TVs from 37" to 70"The Monoprice Commercial Series Premium Mobile TV Cart is the perfect way to move a 37" to 70" TV weighing up to 100 lbs., making it ideal for use in conference rooms, at trade shows, in schools, and any place where video presentations are used. It features a solid frame made of cold‑rolled steel, a hand crank to raise or lower the display, and a TV mount bracket that can be tilted ±10 degrees and rotated 90 degrees for landscape or portrait display orientation. The large, heavy‑duty casters can be locked to ensure the cart stays in place, even on uneven surfaces. The media shelves can be used for placing a DVD player, laptop, or other equipment weighing up to 11 lbs. for additional convenience.Fits VESA® patterns from 200x200 to 600x400Designed for 37" to 70" TVsSupports up to 110 lbs.Hand crank system for effortless height adjustmentHeight adjustable AV equipment shelves above and below TV bracketTV bracket tilts ±10 degrees and rotates 90 degrees for portrait/landscape display orientationFour large, heavy‑duty, lockable castersUL® certified FULLY ADJUSTABLE DESIGNThis Premium Mobile TV Cart from Monoprice™ features a TV bracket that can be effortless raised or lowered using a convenient hand crank. The bracket tilts ±10 degrees and can be rotated 90 degrees to allow for both portrait and landscape display orientation. ADJUSTABLE AV EQUIPMENT SHELVESThis Premium Mobile TV Cart features an AV equipment shelf below the display bracket that can accommodate up to 11 lbs. of equipment. A second AV rack above the display can also hold up to 11 lbs. for additional convenience. "IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"Check your TV's manual for its VESA® mounting pattern or measure the horizontal and vertical distances between the mounting holes (in mm).This mount supports VESA patterns between 200x200 and 600x400.This mount supports TVs weighing up to 110 pounds.The screen size range is only a suggested approximation. Your TV is compatible as long as its VESA mounting pattern is between 200x200 and 600x400 and it weighs no more than 110 pounds. HEAVY‑DUTY STEEL CONSTRUCTIONThe Monoprice™ Commercial Series Premium Mobile TV Cart is constructed of high‑quality, cold‑rolled steel for solid, sturdy build quality that is capable of mounting displays weighing up to 110 lbs. It features four heavy‑duty casters, which allows you to easily move your display wherever it is needed.
